# Stack

## Primary Language

**C** — the core runtime, all commands, object storage, protocol handlers, and library code
are written in C. Approximately 242 `.c` source files at the repository root plus `builtin/`
subdirectory.

## Secondary Languages

| Language | Role |
|----------|------|
| **Shell (POSIX sh)** | Build scripts, CI scripts, test suite (1 049 sharness tests in `t/`) |
| **Perl** | Some helper scripts (disabled by default in this build: `NO_PERL=NoThanks`) |
| **Python** | Some contrib tooling (disabled: `NO_PYTHON=NoThanks`) |

## Version

`v2.54.0` (from `GIT-VERSION-GEN`: `DEF_VER=v2.54.0`)

## Build System

| Layer | Tool |
|-------|------|
| Primary build | **GNU Make** (`Makefile`) |
| Configuration | **Autoconf** (`configure.ac` + generated `configure` script) |
| Optional | `make configure && ./configure` for platform-specific feature detection |

## Optional Runtime Dependencies

| Library | Purpose | Default |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **zlib** | Object compression/decompression | Required |
| **OpenSSL** | SHA-1/SHA-256 hashing, TLS | Enabled by default |
| **libcurl** | HTTP/HTTPS transport (`git clone`, `git fetch` over HTTP) | Enabled by default |
| **libpcre2** | Perl-compatible regex in `git grep` | Optional (`--with-libpcre2`) |
| **expat** | WebDAV XML parsing | Optional |
| **gettext / iconv** | Internationalisation | Optional |

## Code Style

- **clang-format** config present (`.clang-format`) — tabs, 8-space indent, 80-char guideline
- `.editorconfig` mirrors the same indent/tab settings

## Frontend

None — Git is a CLI tool; no frontend framework.

## Containerisation

Not containerised. Distributed as a compiled binary installed system-wide.
